title: Utility is in the Eye of the User: A Critique of NLP Leaderboards
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is a microeconomic critique of NLP leaderboards, arguing that they incentivize accuracy at the expense of other valued qualities like fairness, efficiency, and robustness.
